cards.name: Transform
cards.summary: Legacy CPU version of the Transform effect: moves, scales, skews, rotates and fades the layer inside the effect stack, with its own shutter angle for motion blur. Superseded by the current GPU Transform ('ADBE Geometry2'), which has the same controls.
use_for: opening older templates / projects that already contain it
motion-blurred punch-in on a quote beat in a legacy comp (rebuild with ADBE Geometry2 for new work)
whip / slide transition with built-in shutter blur in old templates
avoid: new work: apply Transform 'ADBE Geometry2' (GPU) instead
scaling 1080p footage above ~130% (visible softness)
rotating without scaling up: empty (transparent) corners appear

params.name: Position
params.does: Moves the image (layer pixels)
params.typical: [960, 540] centre; offset by 1920 px for a whip slide

params.name: Uniform Scale
params.does: Checkbox 0/1: 1 = Scale Height drives both axes

params.name: Scale Height
params.does: Vertical scale %; the single Scale value when Uniform Scale = 1
params.typical: 100-120 for punch-ins

params.name: Scale Width
params.does: Horizontal scale %, used only when Uniform Scale = 0

params.name: Rotation
params.does: Rotation in degrees
params.typical: -5 to 5 for tilt / shake

params.name: Skew
params.does: Skew amount (-70..70)
params.typical: 5-20 for a dynamic slide-in

params.name: Use Composition’s Shutter Angle
params.does: 1 = use the comp motion-blur shutter, 0 = use this effect's Shutter Angle

params.name: Shutter Angle
params.does: Motion blur for animated values of this effect (0-360)

params.name: Opacity
params.does: Opacity % applied inside the effect stack (0-100)
params.typical: 100; keyframe 0->100 for a fade that respects effect order

cards.scripting: Obsolete: apply 'ADBE Geometry2' (Transform, Distort) instead; property names and ranges are the same. The harvested default of Uniform Scale here is 0 (the current effect defaults to 1), so a Scale Height-only animation stretches the image vertically: always set Uniform Scale = 1 first (Scale Height is then the single scale; the recipe does this). 'Use Composition’s Shutter Angle' contains a curly apostrophe (U+2019); set it to 0 so this effect's Shutter Angle (e.g. 180) gives motion blur on animated values. Position / Anchor Point are layer pixels. Sampling 1 = Bilinear, 2 = Bicubic. Premiere equivalent: Transform.

verified.note: Image is scaled up ~125%, rotated ~8 degrees and skewed, with transparent (black) corners exposed, exactly the Transform punch-in/rotate/skew described.

cards.name: Unsharp Mask
cards.summary: Legacy Unsharp Mask: sharpens by raising contrast along edges (image minus a blurred copy). Superseded by the current Unsharp Mask ('ADBE Unsharp Mask2', Blur & Sharpen).
use_for: opening older projects that already contain it
crisping soft archival or upscaled clips in legacy documentary comps
large-radius, low-amount clarity on flat b-roll (rebuild with ADBE Unsharp Mask2 for new work)
avoid: new work: use 'ADBE Unsharp Mask2'
high Amount with small Radius on compressed web news clips (blocks and noise get exaggerated)
halos around faces and on-screen text at high Amount + Radius

params.name: Amount
params.does: Sharpening strength in percent; default 0 = no change
params.typical: 50-150 for detail; 20-40 with a large Radius for clarity

params.name: Radius
params.does: Edge distance in pixels over which contrast is boosted
params.typical: 1-3 for detail; 20-60 for clarity

params.name: Threshold
params.does: Minimum edge difference that gets sharpened, in 0-255 levels; protects skin and noise

params.name: Color Mode
params.does: 0/1 switch (likely luminance-only vs colour sharpening; meaning unverified)

cards.scripting: Obsolete: apply 'ADBE Unsharp Mask2' (Blur & Sharpen) instead; same four controls. Threshold here is 0-255 levels, while the current effect's Threshold is normalised 0..1: divide by 255 when porting. Amount defaults to 0 (nothing visible until set). Color Mode is a 0/1 switch whose meaning is not confirmed; leave 0. Put sharpening after any scale/Transform in the stack. Legacy CPU effect (the GPU path is the Unsharp Mask2 version). Premiere equivalent: Unsharp Mask.

verified.note: Edges (stripes, faces, foreground blocks) are clearly crisper with higher local contrast and light halos; edge energy roughly doubles versus the reference.

cards.name: 2D Text Box
cards.summary: Control panel (pseudo effect) for Adobe's '2D Text Box' presets: it holds the padding, scale, offset and corner-rounding values that the preset's expressions use to draw an auto-sizing rounded box behind a text layer. On its own it renders nothing.
use_for: auto-sizing background plate behind reel captions / subtitles
lower-third name plates that grow with the name length
callout label boxes in explainers
BREAKING / LIVE tag boxes on news reels
avoid: adding the pseudo effect alone: nothing appears without the preset's expressions

Measure Text = 2 During Whole Comp on text that changes (type-on, animators, counters) when you want a fixed box: it re-measures every frame, so the box resizes and jitters with the text; use 1 At Single Time instead
renaming the effect instance: the preset expressions find it by the name '2D Text Box'

params.name: Padding Overall
params.does: Space in pixels between the text bounds and the box on all sides

params.name: Padding Left
params.does: Extra padding on the left only (added to Overall)

params.name: Roundness
params.does: Corner radius in layer pixels, clamped to half the box's shorter side
params.typical: 8-20; very large = pill shape

params.name: Measure Text
params.does: Popup: when the text bounds are measured. 1 At Single Time = size frozen at Measure At Time; 2 During Whole Comp = re-measured every frame (box follows the text); 3 After Time = size at Measure At Time until then, live after; 4 Before Time = live until Measure At Time, then frozen
params.typical: 1 for a fixed plate; 2 for a box that grows with typed-on text; 4 to grow then hold

params.name: Measure At Time [sec]
params.does: Time (seconds) used by modes 1, 3 and 4
params.typical: 0 or the time the full text is on screen

params.name: Scale X
params.does: Box scale % from Scale Origin; with Uniform Scale 1 (default) it scales both axes, with Uniform Scale 0 only the width (Scale Y then sets height)
params.typical: 100; animate 0 -> 100 with Uniform Scale 0 + Scale Origin 2 for a left-to-right wipe-on

params.name: Scale Origin
params.does: Popup: pivot of the box scale (1 Center, 2 Upper Left, 3 Upper Right, 4 Lower Right, 5 Lower Left)
params.typical: 2 for a left-to-right grow

params.name: Offset X
params.does: Shifts the box horizontally in pixels

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect from Support Files/PresetEffects.xml, not in the Effects panel. Apply one of the installed presets instead: 'Presets/Shapes/Elements/2D Text Box (Shape).ffx' (on a shape layer; then point its 'Select a Text Layer' Layer Control at the text layer) or 'Presets/Text/Expressions/2D Text Box (Mask & Effects).ffx' (on the text layer itself: mask + Fill + Stroke). The expressions read the controls by index (twoDTxtBox(1), (2), ...), so never reorder or remove controls. Checkboxes are 0/1: Uniform Scale, Uniform Roundness, Scale Roundness, Round Upper Left / Upper Right / Lower Right / Lower Left. Group headers (Scaling, Padding, Offset, Round Corners, Shape, Enable Per Corner) are not settable; use the flat names. Wipe-on recipe needs Uniform Scale 0 and Scale Origin 2 first. Premiere has no effect equivalent: use the text layer's Background (with corner roundness) in Essential Graphics / Properties.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Animated Shape Control
cards.summary: Pseudo-effect control used by Adobe's animated shape presets (Box Swarm, Kaleidoscopic, Alien Face, Mandala, SpiroMandala): its sliders feed wiggle() expressions that animate the shapes' size, position and rounding. Renders nothing on its own.
use_for: animated abstract background behind explainer titles or AI-education slides
looping texture under a quote card
motion backdrop for intro / outro cards
avoid: adding it alone: it is only a control panel
busy wiggling backgrounds under dense on-screen text
high Speed: jittery, cheap-looking motion

params.name: Speed
params.does: Wiggle frequency base; each preset scales it (Box Swarm x0.02-0.05, Kaleidoscopic /10-/40, Mandala /10), so 10 = roughly 0.2-1 wiggle per second

params.name: Dimensions
params.does: Base shape size [w, h] in pixels; Box Swarm / Kaleidoscopic / Mandala wiggle the size around it

params.name: Spread
params.does: Preset-specific amount: in Box Swarm the position wiggle in pixels; Kaleidoscopic and Mandala reuse it differently (Mandala multiplies Rounding by it)
params.typical: 10-200 in Box Swarm; start from the preset's value elsewhere

params.name: Rounding
params.does: Base roundness of the shapes (Kaleidoscopic and Mandala wiggle around it)

params.name: Random Seed
params.does: Seed for seedRandom(); change it for a different random layout
params.typical: any whole number

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect from PresetEffects.xml. Apply via the presets Presets/Shapes/Backgrounds/Box Swarm.ffx, Kaleidoscopic.ffx or Presets/Shapes/Sprites - Animated/Alien Face - animated.ffx, Mandala - animated.ffx, SpiroMandala.ffx (on a shape layer), then edit these controls. Two different pseudo effects share the display name 'Animated Shape Control': this one ('ADBE CM Animated Shape Control', 5 controls) and 'ADBE CM Animated Shape 3' (Speed + Random Seed only); address them by match name. Dimensions is a 2D point in layer pixels (harvested default [960, 540]) but is used as a size, not a position. Random Seed is an angle-type control used as a seed. Expressions (seedRandom + wiggle) find the effect by display name, so do not rename it.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Animated Shape Control
cards.summary: Two-control pseudo effect (Speed, Random Seed) used by Adobe's animated shape presets such as Nerve Net, Ring Chart, Wireframe Worm, Circular - cellular division and Dancing Knot; it sets how fast and with which random pattern their wiggle() expressions move. Renders nothing on its own.
use_for: tech / network backdrop for AI-education explainers (Nerve Net)
animated ring-chart decoration behind a statistic
looping abstract element for intro cards
avoid: adding it alone: it is only a control panel
high Speed: frantic motion distracts from narration

params.name: Speed
params.does: Wiggle frequency base; presets divide it heavily (Ring Chart /50 and /100, Nerve Net /200 to /1220), so at 10 Nerve Net is almost static
params.typical: start from the preset's value; 10-30 for Ring Chart, 50-300 for visible Nerve Net drift

params.name: Random Seed
params.does: Seed for seedRandom(); change for a different pattern
params.typical: any whole number

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect from PresetEffects.xml. Apply via Presets/Shapes/Backgrounds/Nerve Net - Circular.ffx, Nerve Net - Penta.ffx, Presets/Shapes/Elements/Ring Chart.ffx, Wireframe Worm.ffx, or Presets/Shapes/Sprites - Animated/Circular - cellular division.ffx, Dancing Knot.ffx (on a shape layer). Shares the display name 'Animated Shape Control' with 'ADBE CM Animated Shape Control'; address by match name 'ADBE CM Animated Shape 3'. Expressions find it by display name, so do not rename it.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Autoscroll - horizontal
cards.summary: Control for the 'Autoscroll - horizontal' behaviour preset: one Speed slider drives a Motion Tile expression that scrolls the layer's content sideways endlessly, wrapping seamlessly. Alone it renders nothing.
use_for: news ticker / headline crawl strip at the bottom of a news reel
endless scrolling logo, flag or photo strip
slow looping pan of a background texture behind titles
avoid: adding the control without the preset (no Motion Tile, no motion)
speeds above ~400 px/s strobe at 25/30 fps
artwork whose left and right edges do not match shows a seam at the wrap

params.name: Speed (pixels/second)
params.does: Scroll speed in pixels per second from the layer in-point; positive = content moves right, negative = left
params.typical: -80 to -200 for a right-to-left news crawl

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect. Apply Presets/Behaviors/Autoscroll - horizontal.ffx: it adds this control plus Motion Tile ('ADBE Tile') with expressions Tile Center = [width/2 + Speed*(time-inPoint)*(100/scale[0]), height/2] and Output Width = comp width / scaled layer width * 100, so the tiled layer fills the comp width and loops. Keep Speed static: the offset is Speed*time, so keyframing Speed makes the content jump. Premiere: keyframe Offset's Shift Center To linearly for the same wrap-around scroll.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Autoscroll - vertical
cards.summary: Control for the 'Autoscroll - vertical' behaviour preset: one Speed slider drives a Motion Tile expression that scrolls the layer's content up or down endlessly, wrapping seamlessly. Alone it renders nothing.
use_for: end-credits / sources roll in documentaries
scrolling document, tweet or headline list behind a presenter
social-feed scroll mock-up in explainer reels
avoid: adding the control without the preset (no Motion Tile, no motion)
fast scrolls of small text: unreadable and strobing
artwork whose top and bottom edges do not match shows a seam at the wrap

params.name: Speed (pixels/second)
params.does: Scroll speed in pixels per second from the layer in-point; negative = content moves up (default -25), positive = down

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect. Apply Presets/Behaviors/Autoscroll - vertical.ffx: it adds this control plus Motion Tile with expressions Tile Center = [width/2, height/2 + Speed*(time-inPoint)*(100/scale[0])] and Output Height = comp height / scaled layer height * 100. Keep Speed static (offset = Speed*time, keyframing makes jumps). Premiere: keyframe Offset's Shift Center To, or roll a title, for the same effect.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Bounce
cards.summary: Parameter-holder pseudo effect for a decaying bounce behaviour (amplitude, frequency, decay, delay, repeat cycle). No preset installed with AE 2026 uses it, so it does nothing unless an expression on the layer reads it.
use_for: springy pop-in of icons or lower-third elements (with our own expression)
bouncing callout arrow in explainers
repeating bounce on a CTA / subscribe badge using Cycle Time
avoid: adding it expecting motion: it renders nothing
large bounces on serious news graphics look cartoonish

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: Bounce strength (default 250); unit depends on the expression that reads it (the example expressions use Amplitude/10 = % of Scale)
params.typical: 50-250 with the example expression (= 5-25 % scale overshoot); 50-100 for news graphics

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Bounces per second (inferred)

params.name: Decay
params.does: How fast the bounce settles (inferred)

params.name: Delay
params.does: Seconds before the bounce starts (inferred)

params.name: Cycle Time
params.does: Seconds between repeats, 0 = once (inferred)

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect defined in PresetEffects.xml ('ADBE DE Bounce'); no .ffx in AE 2026 Support Files/Presets or Documents/Adobe uses it, so a script must also write the expression. Example on Scale: c=effect('Bounce'); t=time-inPoint-c('Delay'); if(c('Cycle Time')>0) t=t%c('Cycle Time'); b=t<0?0:c('Amplitude')/10*Math.sin(c('Frequency')*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(c('Decay')*t); value+[b,b]. The expression must reference the effect by its instance name. Parameter meanings beyond the names are inferred (low confidence). Premiere has no equivalent: keyframe Scale with an overshoot.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Bounce At Marker
cards.summary: Parameter-holder pseudo effect for a decaying bounce that retriggers at each layer marker (amplitude, frequency, decay). No installed preset uses it, so it does nothing unless an expression reads it.
use_for: pop a word, icon or counter on each narration beat marked with layer markers
bump a logo on edit points in a reel
emphasis bounces timed to VO keywords in explainers
avoid: adding it expecting motion: it renders nothing
markers closer together than the decay time make stacked, messy bounces

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: Bounce strength (default 250); unit depends on the expression that reads it (the example expressions use Amplitude/10 = % of Scale)
params.typical: 50-250 with the example expression (= 5-25 % scale overshoot); 50-100 for news graphics

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Bounces per second (inferred)

params.name: Decay
params.does: How fast each bounce settles (inferred)

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect ('ADBE DE Bounce At Marker'); no installed preset uses it, so write the expression too and add layer markers at the trigger times. Example on Scale: c=effect('Bounce At Marker'); n=0; if(marker.numKeys>0){n=marker.nearestKey(time).index; if(marker.key(n).time>time) n--;} b=0; if(n>0){t=time-marker.key(n).time; b=c('Amplitude')/10*Math.sin(c('Frequency')*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(c('Decay')*t);} value+[b,b]. Parameter meanings are inferred from names (low confidence).

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Bounce On Beat
cards.summary: Parameter-holder pseudo effect for a bounce triggered whenever an audio-amplitude layer crosses a threshold (amplitude, frequency, decay, audio layer, threshold). Needs an 'Audio Amplitude' keyframe layer and an expression; renders nothing on its own.
use_for: logo or text bouncing to the music beat in reels
beat-reactive graphics in trailer title cards
music-driven icon pops in AI-education intros
avoid: adding it without an Audio Amplitude layer and an expression: nothing happens
threshold too low: it fires on every frame and jitters

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: Bounce strength (default 250); unit depends on the expression that reads it (the example expressions use Amplitude/10 = % of Scale)
params.typical: 50-250 with the example expression (= 5-25 % scale overshoot); 50-100 for news graphics

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Bounces per second (inferred)

params.name: Decay
params.does: How fast each bounce settles (inferred)

params.name: Audio Keyframe Layer
params.does: Layer holding audio amplitude keyframes (from Convert Audio to Keyframes)
params.typical: the 'Audio Amplitude' null

params.name: Audio Threshold
params.does: Amplitude level that counts as a beat (0-100)
params.typical: 10-30, tune to the track

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect ('ADBE DE Bounce On Beat'); no installed preset uses it. Needs: (1) an 'Audio Amplitude' layer made with Animation > Keyframe Assistant > Convert Audio to Keyframes; (2) 'Audio Keyframe Layer' is a layer-type property that cannot be set from a props spec: set it in ExtendScript with effect.property('Audio Keyframe Layer').setValue(layerIndex); (3) an expression on the target property that finds the last time the amplitude crossed Audio Threshold and adds a decaying sine (same form as Bounce). Parameter meanings are inferred (low confidence). Also effectively needs_input (audio).

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Bounce Random
cards.summary: Parameter-holder pseudo effect for a decaying bounce that retriggers at random intervals between Min Delay and Max Delay seconds. No installed preset uses it, so it does nothing unless an expression reads it.
use_for: idle 'alive' motion on icons or stickers in explainer reels
staggered random pops across a grid of elements
attention-grabbing CTA badge that bounces now and then
avoid: adding it expecting motion: it renders nothing
too short delays: constant jitter that looks broken

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: Bounce strength (default 250); unit depends on the expression that reads it (the example expressions use Amplitude/10 = % of Scale)
params.typical: 50-250 with the example expression (= 5-25 % scale overshoot); 50-100 for news graphics

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Bounces per second (inferred)

params.name: Decay
params.does: How fast each bounce settles (inferred)

params.name: Min Delay
params.does: Shortest random wait between bounces, seconds (inferred)

params.name: Max Delay
params.does: Longest random wait between bounces, seconds (inferred)

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect ('ADBE DE Bounce Random'); no installed preset uses it, so write the expression too: seedRandom(index, true), walk forward from inPoint adding random(Min Delay, Max Delay) until past time to find the last trigger, then add the decaying sine (same form as Bounce). Keep Max Delay >= Min Delay. Parameter meanings are inferred from names (low confidence).

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.

cards.name: Card Wipe Master Control
cards.summary: Master slider for Adobe's three Card Wipe transition presets (2D fractured, 3D pixelstorm, 3D swing): one Transition Completion percentage drives the Card Wipe effect's completion plus its card rotation / jitter settings through expressions, and a checkbox flips the flip direction. Alone it renders nothing.
use_for: tile-flip reveal of a headline card or press photo in news reels
segment transition in political explainers
trailer-style pixelstorm reveal of a title
avoid: overuse: dated 2000s broadcast look
leaving the default 50: the layer sits mid-transition (half-wiped in 3D swing, still jittering in the other two)
on talking heads mid-sentence

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: 0-100 %: 0 = layer fully wiped away, 100 = fully assembled. 3D swing maps it to Card Wipe completion 100 -> 0 over the whole range; 2D fractured and 3D pixelstorm finish the card reveal by 33 and spend 33-100 settling rotation / jitter
params.typical: keyframe 0 -> 100 over 0.8-1.5 s to transition in

params.name: reverse direction
params.does: Checkbox 0/1: flips the card rotation / wipe side

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect. Apply Presets/Transitions - Movement/Card Wipe - 2D fractured.ffx, Card Wipe - 3D pixelstorm.ffx or Card Wipe - 3D swing.ffx to the incoming layer. In 3D swing the Card Wipe completion = linear(TC, 0, 100, 100, 0); in 2D fractured and 3D pixelstorm it is linear(TC, 0, 33, 100, 0) (reveal done by 33, the rest settles jitter/rotation). In all three keyframe this control 0 -> 100 to bring the layer in and 100 -> 0 to take it out. Default is 50 (half-wiped): always keyframe it or set 100. 'reverse direction' is lower-case in the property name; 0/1. Expressions find the effect by its display name, so do not rename it. Render cost comes from the Card Wipe effect it drives. Premiere has no Card Wipe equivalent.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (pseudo-effect control panel that renders nothing on its own), so no gallery frame was rendered.
